top_signals.title: Bolivia Revamps Gold Export Rules to Attract More Dollars
top_signals.summary: Bolivia aims to boost private gold exports while increasing dollar inflows to local banks in a reform backed by President Rodrigo Paz that ends a three-year-old system overseen by the central bank.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: New World’s Debt Swap Falls Short of Cap by Early Deadline
top_signals.summary: Participation in distressed Hong Kong developer New World Development Co.’s debt swap offer came in below its overall target by an early bird deadline for creditors this week.
